g.text: Three branches, each with its own pile of raw tickets.
Map: each branch tallies only its own pile. No trips yet.
Each item (key) gets exactly one owner.
Shuffle: all 3 burger tallies go to the burger owner (3 trips so far).
Shuffle: all 3 fries tallies go to the fries owner (6 trips so far).
Shuffle: all 3 pizza tallies go to the pizza owner (9 trips so far).
Reduce: each owner adds up its own key. burger 10, fries 11, pizza 8.
Same shape as Monday, just relabeled. Only the shuffle needed trips.
